        (function () {

            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Agendas & Minutes</h1>

<p>Council meetings are generally scheduled for the fourth Thursday of every month. <br />
Agendas for all meetings of Council and Delegated Committees are made available to the public on this page at least 48 hours prior to each meeting. Hard copies can be provided on request. Draft and confirmed minutes of meetings open to the public will be made available on this page as soon as practicable.</p>
<p>Councillors are required to comply with the Victorian Government’s Model Code of Conduct which came into effect on 26 October 2024 and which can be viewed <a href="https://www.mildura.vic.gov.au/Council/About-Council/Governance/Councillor-Code-of-Conduct">here</a>.</p>
<p>Agendas and minutes from earlier Council meetings (prior to those published below) are available upon request. Please contact the Governance team on <a href="tel:0350188100">03 5018 8100</a> if you would like copies. </p>
<p>Please note, we have developed Conditions of Entry for our Council meetings to ensure a safe environment for visitors and staff. You can read the conditions here: <a href="https://www.mildura.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-meetings/Council-Meeting-Conditions-of-Entry">Council Meeting Conditions of Entry</a></p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Agendas & Minutes</h1>

<p>Council meetings are generally scheduled for the fourth Thursday of every month. <br />
Agendas for all meetings of Council and Delegated Committees are made available to the public on this page at least 48 hours prior to each meeting. Hard copies can be provided on request. Draft and confirmed minutes of meetings open to the public will be made available on this page as soon as practicable.</p>
<p>Councillors are required to comply with the Victorian Government’s Model Code of Conduct which came into effect on 26 October 2024 and which can be viewed <a href="https://www.mildura.vic.gov.au/Council/About-Council/Governance/Councillor-Code-of-Conduct">here</a>.</p>
<p>Agendas and minutes from earlier Council meetings (prior to those published below) are available upon request. Please contact the Governance team on <a href="tel:0350188100">03 5018 8100</a> if you would like copies. </p>
<p>Please note, we have developed Conditions of Entry for our Council meetings to ensure a safe environment for visitors and staff. You can read the conditions here: <a href="https://www.mildura.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-meetings/Council-Meeting-Conditions-of-Entry">Council Meeting Conditions of Entry</a></p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Agendas & Minutes</h1>

<p>Council meetings are generally scheduled for the fourth Thursday of every month. <br />
Agendas for all meetings of Council and Delegated Committees are made available to the public on this page at least 48 hours prior to each meeting. Hard copies can be provided on request. Draft and confirmed minutes of meetings open to the public will be made available on this page as soon as practicable.</p>
<p>Councillors are required to comply with the Victorian Government’s Model Code of Conduct which came into effect on 26 October 2024 and which can be viewed <a href="https://www.mildura.vic.gov.au/Council/About-Council/Governance/Councillor-Code-of-Conduct">here</a>.</p>
<p>Agendas and minutes from earlier Council meetings (prior to those published below) are available upon request. Please contact the Governance team on <a href="tel:0350188100">03 5018 8100</a> if you would like copies. </p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Agendas & Minutes</h1>

<p>Council meetings are generally scheduled for the fourth Thursday of every month. <br />
Agendas for all meetings of Council and Delegated Committees are made available to the public on this page at least 48 hours prior to each meeting. Hard copies can be provided on request. Draft and confirmed minutes of meetings open to the public will be made available on this page as soon as practicable.</p>
<p>Councillors are required to comply with the Victorian Government’s Model Code of Conduct which came into effect on 26 October 2024 and which can be viewed <a href="https://www.mildura.vic.gov.au/Council/About-Council/Governance/Councillor-Code-of-Conduct">here</a>.</p>
<p>Agendas and minutes from earlier Council meetings (prior to those published below) are available upon request. Please contact the Governance team on <a href="tel:0350188100">03 5018 8100</a> if you would like copies. </p>
<p>Please note, we have developed Conditions of Entry for our Council meetings to ensure a safe environment for visitors and staff. You can read the conditions here: <a href="https://www.mildura.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-meetings/Council-Meeting-Conditions-of-Entry">Council Meeting Conditions of Entry</a></p>

        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }

                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Agendas & Minutes</h1>

<p>Council meetings are generally scheduled for the fourth Thursday of every month. <br />
Agendas for all meetings of Council and Delegated Committees are made available to the public on this page at least 48 hours prior to each meeting. Hard copies can be provided on request. Draft and confirmed minutes of meetings open to the public will be made available on this page as soon as practicable.</p>
<p>Councillors are required to comply with the Victorian Government’s Model Code of Conduct which came into effect on 26 October 2024 and which can be viewed <a href="https://www.mildura.vic.gov.au/Council/About-Council/Governance/Councillor-Code-of-Conduct">here</a>.</p>
<p>Agendas and minutes from earlier Council meetings (prior to those published below) are available upon request. Please contact the Governance team on <a href="tel:0350188100">03 5018 8100</a> if you would like copies. </p>
<p>Please note, we have developed Conditions of Entry for our Council meetings to ensure a safe environment for visitors and staff. You can read the conditions here: <a href="https://www.mildura.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-meetings/Council-Meeting-Conditions-of-Entry">Council Meeting Conditions of Entry</a></p>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Agendas & Minutes</h1>

<p>Council meetings are generally scheduled for the fourth Thursday of every month. <br />
Agendas for all meetings of Council and Delegated Committees are made available to the public on this page at least 48 hours prior to each meeting. Hard copies can be provided on request. Draft and confirmed minutes of meetings open to the public will be made available on this page as soon as practicable.</p>
<p>Councillors are required to comply with the Victorian Government’s Model Code of Conduct which came into effect on 26 October 2024 and which can be viewed <a href="https://www.mildura.vic.gov.au/Council/About-Council/Governance/Councillor-Code-of-Conduct">here</a>.</p>
<p>Agendas and minutes from earlier Council meetings (prior to those published below) are available upon request. Please contact the Governance team on <a href="tel:0350188100">03 5018 8100</a> if you would like copies. </p>
<p>Please note, we have developed Conditions of Entry for our Council meetings to ensure a safe environment for visitors and staff. You can read the conditions here: <a href="https://www.mildura.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-meetings/Council-Meeting-Conditions-of-Entry">Council Meeting Conditions of Entry</a></p>

        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Agendas & Minutes</h1>

<p>Council meetings are generally scheduled for the fourth Thursday of every month. <br />
Agendas for all meetings of Council and Delegated Committees are made available to the public on this page at least 48 hours prior to each meeting. Hard copies can be provided on request. Draft and confirmed minutes of meetings open to the public will be made available on this page as soon as practicable.</p>
<p>Councillors are required to comply with the Victorian Government’s Model Code of Conduct which came into effect on 26 October 2024 and which can be viewed <a href="https://www.mildura.vic.gov.au/Council/About-Council/Governance/Councillor-Code-of-Conduct">here</a>.</p>
<p>Agendas and minutes from earlier Council meetings (prior to those published below) are available upon request. Please contact the Governance team on <a href="tel:0350188100">03 5018 8100</a> if you would like copies. </p>
<p>Please note, we have developed Conditions of Entry for our Council meetings to ensure a safe environment for visitors and staff. You can read the conditions here: <a href="https://www.mildura.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-meetings/Council-Meeting-Conditions-of-Entry">Council Meeting Conditions of Entry</a></p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Agendas & Minutes</h1>

<p>Council meetings are generally scheduled for the fourth Thursday of every month. <br />
Agendas for all meetings of Council and Delegated Committees are made available to the public on this page at least 48 hours prior to each meeting. Hard copies can be provided on request. Draft and confirmed minutes of meetings open to the public will be made available on this page as soon as practicable.</p>
<p>Councillors are required to comply with the Victorian Government’s Model Code of Conduct which came into effect on 26 October 2024 and which can be viewed <a href="https://www.mildura.vic.gov.au/Council/About-Council/Governance/Councillor-Code-of-Conduct">here</a>.</p>
<p>Agendas and minutes from earlier Council meetings (prior to those published below) are available upon request. Please contact the Governance team on <a href="tel:0350188100">03 5018 8100</a> if you would like copies. </p>
<p>Please note, we have developed Conditions of Entry for our Council meetings to ensure a safe environment for visitors and staff. You can read the conditions here: <a href="https://www.mildura.vic.gov.au/Council/Council-meetings/Council-Meeting-Conditions-of-Entry">Council Meeting Conditions of Entry</a></p>
